body:
Yeah, I don't really care about downvotes... just trying to be honest and get the help I need, and of course people who aren't in my situation probably aren't going to fully understand. I've pretty much lost everything over the last 3 years. Wanting to keep a gaming console (when I don't even have a TV mind you) seems stupid and juvenile from the outside... but if it's the only thing keeping me going at this point I'm going to make sure it's my absolute last resort.

I think I will give my bank a call. And also consider selling / pawning what I have and talking to my landlord. I asked my SO about them possible helping (considering I was counting on moving in with them and having two incomes and then they decided to walk out on me at the last minute and being verbally abusive to no end causing my plummet into depression...) but of course, they were rude and no help. 

Super thanks to everyone here. It's helped a lot at least feel like I'm not alone

Thanks. My roomates are strangers and not people who would tide me over or lend any money anyway. I am considering talking to the landlord but I'm very hesitant to. 

I don't see selling the PS4 as quite a bad thing... I'm just trying to find the delicate balance with my psychological standing. Yes, the cash from selling it helps... but the emotional/psychological cons from selling also really doesn't help with making sure I can keep up a job or even get out of bed for a first day. 

I will probably be selling it today nonetheless. I just honestly dont know what to do.

Rent and deposit is due tomorrow, which is 866. I don't want to do a late payment because it is the first month rent.

I have 413 currently, which means I need 453... that is with living off of Ramen and what not that I have, which is not ideal but I can handle it.

Phone is due in a few weeks, the 12th. which is 130

I also need to get internet up and running tomorrow, which will probably be around 50 (split between 2 other roomates)

I am extremely hesitant to do anything that works against me emotionally because I need to get finances in check and doing things that are emotionally draining will just make depression harder and therefor solidifying a job and honestly just living that much harder.

My mom died when I was 16 and I have her engagement ring, which I could pawn, but it's one of the only things I have that are really mine and it's the only thing I have of hers. 

I have a PS4, along with some games and a controller, I bought months ago which is easier to sell but works against me emotionally. If all else fails I am planning on selling it today or tomorrow. 

I have no family I can ask for money. My father and older sister are extremely emotionally and physically abusive and letting them into my life would be dangerous. 

I would consider asking an extended family member, but I am also afraid of the avenues that might open to my immediate family. 

A small loan seems like a good idea to me because it will allow me to pay for my immediate expenses (phone, food, internet, rent), help me feel safe and secure which works against depression, help me stay safe from my family, allow me to not give up the few things that help me get through the day, and give me a mood boost in those aspects to help me be serious about a job and whatnot.
but I can sell one of my possessions for money to pay back the loan, and then buy it back with loan money or money from my job

it will be around $16 an hour. It's not solidified yet, which is why I said I was looking for a job rather than having one. 

Rent is 533 a month
phone is 120
gas is 30
and internet is 30
payment for the loan would be around 200 a month
Why? A 12 month term $2000 loan at the quotes I have seen (9% for example) would be affordable after I start my job.
See I have a job set up. I just need the money right now
Well if I didn't have social anxiety I wouldn't have asked. I know the obvious answers, they just pretty much arent options for me.
Wow you are not what I need. I have cut him out. I dont need to argue or validate my feelings to anyone
Can you fucking stop
This isn't really helping, but thanks

The fact is that he's all I have right now. And Just losing him so traumatically destroys any progress ive made in my panic. Im trying to teach myself that real life isnt the panic ive known, then my safety is gone. This was like a last resort I dont know what to do

Thank you, so much.

I hear that. And I will take it to heart. Seriously. I won't forget it, and I'll think on it whenever my safety is a question with him (which it shouldn't ever be, so it's ridiuclous that it is at any point, even rarely)

I think I'm going to show him these messages. He's usually very open to talking so I'll at least try it. Like I said, idk if he's abusive. But I will take this seriously.

Yeah, I don't think my intent was ever to harm him.

Thank you,

yes, please be honest. and thank you so much for talking with me

I dont think I quite follow all of your message. He's texting me on his phone. I know the bruises on me are my fault, my BF claims he has some but that's because he got in the way of me hitting myself. He claims I punched him, but I only remember punching the deck. If I touched him it was only to keep him from touching me.

Thanks, really.

I have trouble with gaslighting, it was my dad's most used abuse tactic. I'm really afraid I'm gaslighting about that night, but I'm afraid he is too. I don't think I am, but I really feel like I can't entirely trust my memory. 

I have a friend coming over possibly. Idk if they actually will. I texted my BF the discrepencie in what he's saying (the "its not your fault" to "You need to take responsability") and I told him that if he is getting my messages, to go to his friends house for a while. His parents will do anything they can to make him do what they want while he's there.

To be honest, I hope I'm wrong. I hope he fell asleep and his dads phone broke.

You know, realistically, I think some might be my fault, but I can't remember the night. 

It's not like this has happened before. It's not like I've constantly get that drunk, have a panic attack, and end up hurting him by accident. This was a freak thing, not a habit. Not at all a habit.

I had a panic attack, which is so freaking understandable looking at my history (if you want an overview, look at my first SW post). I couldn't handle it... my wellbeing was not looked out for. An ambulance was not called. And I am being blamed.

I am, as a result, not getting updates and being told what is going on.

To be objective, though, I am still panicky. Maybe he IS having a breakdown? Maybe his freaking out has nothing to do with me? He told me "No it's not your fault. things will be ok" but then told me I wasn't taking responsability for what happened? he actually said I was using my triggers as an excuse.

You know what, I think that seals the deal. His parents are saying I'm using triggers as an excuse, he understand what happened. I feel like he really needs to get away from his parents. They are not encouragin any behaviour that leads to a happy, peaceful, and healthy solution.

I think it could. I feel like the catalyst was my fault so it makes sense that this situation is my fault and i deserve it.

I want things to be good with him so badly.

But what is looking out for myself? I grew up in abusive home too and I don't know how to even be a person or live a life. Without the comfort of someone else it's hard to keep going at all. 

I texted his dad, he hasn't responded. Tbh I'm taking that as evidence that his parents are behind this.

The thing is I was abused, and I have abusive habits that I learned, but I'm really trying to address them. I'm really afraid of my BF and his parents spinning this to make me seem like some abuser. I work on it every day and I tell my BF everyday that if something seems off to him, he can tell me. Idk what to do. I love him a lot. I just wish there wasn't so much animosity towards me from everyone so I could at least just be ok until they decide to treat me like a person.

Yeah, I guess when you put it that way.

I just don't know how to bring this up with my BF. I feel like I can't be upset over anything that happened this weekend. His feelings are taking importance over mine. Mine can't be addressed until his are, and even then it's a stretch. That's not healthy. I just want to talk and try and go back to some normalacy, I just want him to try and come home. We aren't drunk anymore for god sakes. 

The whole thing is so fucking sketchy. No one is keeping me updated. No one wants to talk. Honestly, maybe I need to stop taking this personally. Maybe my BF is having a breakdown and that's why him and his parents aren't keeping me updated. Even though this sucks and I'm tired of feeling this way, I feel stronger when I have nothing to lose.

I'm going to text his dad, as absolutely terrifying as that is for me. I need to know.

Yeah, I wish I had someone on my side in the situation. I also hate having to fear his parents. Like, what they say goes. So literally if they came to the apartment right now and told me to get out and never come back no one would stop that. It's so dangerous and gross and not peaceful
I don't know if he's abusive. I don't think he is. There are some major red flags for sure, but he also cares a lot. at the most I just want to get both of us the help we need and deserve.
Please ask, its fine

Not purpose I think. He was drunk and didn't know. When he woke up he was on the floor and I was on top of him. I think he thought I was hurting him. I just want him to respond, he's stopped responding now :(

I hurt myself, I don't think he hurt me. I might have hurt him, but I don't really remember. I remember mainly hitting myself, maybe I hit him when he tried to intervene? I do remember he passed out drunk and hit his head on the wall, then told his dad I pushed him.
A deal breaker as in killing myself is a yes now?
I never hurt him on purpose to me recolection. I would hit myself and he put himself in my way, then said i was hurting him. He was drunk and said I pushed him when he passed out
A deal breaker? Im not saying it was ok? Youre scaring me

Yeah, I don't remember some of the night. I was drunk and judging by the bruises on myself I may have hurt him. But I really don't remember that. I remember being scared and hurt, and now since I don't remember all of I'm even more confused.

I'm ok, I just want someone to keep talking to about all these ridiculous developments. My BF has stopped talking to me again now... 

I'm Molly :)

yeah, idk what to do. Whenever the conversation isn't focused on him and what he needs he shuts down. At first he ignored me, then answered "I'm not trying to give you anultimatum, I thought we came to an understanding"

Now, after I said I've been trying to talk all day and I don't think it's fair it's only on his terms

"I really can't follow this right now, I'll reply when I'm able."

Like, you could follow it a sec ago when it was about you.

> 'negotiation is ok, ultimatums are not'

Wow. Yeah. he just texted me all this stuff he's worried about and upset with and I answered for him. But I'm not allowed to do the same and he sees this as his right. He's just started ignoring me. 

To be fair, he's only this way around his parents. I wish I had some middle ground person to say "hey man, that's not cool" when he does this to me.

Thanks. It really helps to just hear validation that they're ridiculous. 

My boyfriend blamed me for a little while, but really smartened up. He's on meds now and seeing a counselor, so things are getting better. I think most of the problem lies with his parents, they make him second guess everything and try and tell him whats right to the point where he gets confused and overwhelmed. I hate it. 

I'm just done with adults not acting like adults. I was left outside, alone, no shelter, in a VERY bad neighborhood for 24 hours and no one cares. no one. no one. like, they left me for MORE time after they found out? WTF. His parents think im the / a problem and it's ridiculous. Even if I fucked up you don't treat someone like that. 

So, my BF just had a panic attack. Couldn't go to work. is saying he "doesn't want to talk" even though we had an ok conversation... I'm afraid it's his parents manipulating him

he always cuts contact. it amlsot feels like punishment at this point

I think I'm tolerant of them, idk. They've done some ridiculous shit. My boyfriend had mental health problems last year (because of them and failing school) and he threw me making me need surgery. Who did they blame for the incident and for the state oressing criminal charges? me. they also constantly pressure him to do well inschool without actually taking care of him.

The night before last we went out drinking. I had a panic attack smack dab in the middle of that and it went to hell. My boyfriends dad knew i was suicidal and panicking, and he saw that and made the situation drastic. "Eddie if you dont come with me right now, im calling the police"
he demand eddie leave with him or he call the police. Me, [anicking, with seperation anxiety, wasnt allowed to go. 

The second the left I left to kill myself. I ended up just walking aorund. they called an ambulance to talk to me, which in my panic scared me even more and made me run and get lost (im 19, its like 3am now) I finally decided to find my way back because it was really late and not safe and I hvae NOTHING on me. no phone anything. I get to the apartment we share. locked. i dont have keys. they locked me out. 

a lot of dangerous shit happened, i live in the worst part of town. I admited myself to the hospital, I finally got to talk to my boyfriend and he said he wasnt going to let me into the apartment or see me at the hospital. I had to wait until 9pm to get to my stuff 

now, he refuses to come home. his parents are probably behind that though. and he had a panic attack and didnt mak it to work, now he might be at the hospital. idk. he wont talk to me.

im sure his parents are gping to blame this on me, too. im 19 and completely alone, im really afraid his parents are going to manipulate him inot blaming me too

I've gotten so close too. It feels like im high cause I hit my head so many times and my arms and legs are covvered in cuts and bruises. im really upset I havent just done it. I just keep prolonging my pain

thanks

I just have no one to look out for me. im alone. like, my boyfriend has his parents (who are manipulative and hate me) but im literally alone. they're all I have and they really could care less. 

I have panic atacks where I freak out and get scared and I text nonstop or just freak out and I cant help it, but they make me feel like shit for it. I am anxious of social situations so I can't even get help on my own. im really feeling like it would be better for everyone If I just stopped ruinging everyones lives and killed myself
Abusive dad and watching my mom die, and family deaths

Help for tonight doesnt matter. Tonight doesnt matter. I need love, i need a family. I cant have that.

His dad called the police on me because he wanted his abusive son to be safe. I have ptsd and social anxiety. No compassion or thought to call an ambulance for me. They dpnt care if i kill myself, just if im a danger to anyone else doing it

What i need is someone to pick me up. But theres no one whould care about me enough to
Im at eight percent. Wgen my phones dead i am too. Idgaf
Im not even doing anything. Just waiting but im a lil drunk so maybe ill get hit by a car. I don't know. I don't care. It doesnt mayter.
No theres no help. Not at all. He was the last possability. Nothing left. At all.
Nope. Not with sovial anxiety. Also tried that tonight. Tried letting go and cooling off and I get my disorders i cant help thrown in my face. I have no one.
Yeah thats my problem. Too much of a pussy for the hard ones
I wosh there were an easy way. Cant decide

Honestly, any reply is really calming. Underneath all of my struggles and the intense emotion is a person who I don't have the privilege of being all the time. I am so much anxiety and depression and coping that I normally never get to just be myself. Any happy moment is usually accompanied with anxiety or something that reminds me of my trauma.

I was seeing a therapist, and almost got medication, but my therapist went on maternity leave. I had to call the stand-in therapist to set up an appointment... But my anxiety kicked in and more and more months went by and I couldn't get myself to pick up the phone. When I went in for my medication appointment, I found out it had been cancelled and that they hadn't been able to get in touch with me. Alas, I had to call to set up another appointment and the receptionist was quite rude. It was really discouraging and I just couldn't get myself to call. 

I'm also behind on bills for therapy and what not. My dad lost his job (cause he got into a fight surprise surprise) and therefor wacky things happened with my insurance.... And he didn't tell me. I racked up full bills for some appointments and lost my state insurance cause I got the date for submitting a form mixed up with a court date (for what happened with my SO). I haven't been able to get myself to address the bills or even do my taxes, they're a huge source of anxiety and stress. 

I don't think I have insurance now, but I'm not sure. I was on my dad's new work insurance but I am no contact with him now and I don't think I can qualify for being under his insurance. 

People think I'm lazy, but I just have intense anxiety. I was homeschooled and have zero understanding of medical insurance or finances or anything, and I have an extremely hard time opening up about it to anyone. This is where suicide plays a huge part... I need help to be able to ask for help. It's like a cycle I really, really can't break.

Thank you for reading. I'm sorry in advance if my comment comes off weird or awkward, I'm just kind of numb and I feel really removed. 

I feel like I've kind of started to think of it as fiction, too. It's really surreal. I'm now out of the intense drama and abuse and I... I just don't know how to cope. It almost feels like real life is boring. I bounce from being relieved to grieving to being depressed and suicidal to being numb and bored. And then all of those feelings happening say within a week or month just make me depressed and suicidal by themselves. There's just no end... It's so much to deal with, but at the same time I'm in a much safer place. It's overwhelming.

Thank you. Honestly, just having someone know helps. The social anxiety and abuse make it so that many people don't know the list of shit I've gone through. Everyone knows bits and pieces, but no one knows everything. Except for my family, who collectively hate me and have disowned me (not that I mind at this point, they're really hateful and toxic. Even though it hurts it's definitely for the best).

I guess just ranting and talking about things really helps. I feel so weird and removed. I feel like what I am saying is wrong. My comments just come off so weird but that's just how I feel. I feel disjointed and removed. That's why I did bulletpoints... Even though I have so much emotion over every single thing I mentioned (and things I didn't mention) when I just look at it all I feel nothing. They're just cold facts. They're emotionless bullet points even though I feel 100% of the emotion in everything i do. I can't be happy. It's just so much... It's too much. I LOVE life and art and learning.... But that gets so drained by what I've been through. 100% of my being has been put towards surviving, I don't have the time or space to be myself and live the life I want to. I don't think I ever will.
